the-hobbit.title: The Hobbit
the-hobbit.author: J.R.R. Tolkien
the-hobbit.description: A perfect book. And if you disagree with me on that this early on, too bad. Stop trying to read. You're bad at it.
the-hobbit.danielQuote: Were you more enamored by the beauty, world, and lore of it, or just the creative choices?

questions.text: What hooked you about The Hobbit?

options.text: The dragons, magic, and epic fantasy world!
Great story, but not so into all the dragon stuff

wizard-of-earthsea.title: A Wizard of Earthsea
wizard-of-earthsea.author: Ursula K. Le Guin
wizard-of-earthsea.description: A transitional story from classic to modern fantasy with a vastly different taste to epic fantasy worldbuilding.
wizard-of-earthsea.danielQuote: Do you want something darker or did you enjoy the lighter escapism that Wizard of Earthsea's particularly beautiful prose provided?

questions.text: How did this hit for you?

options.text: Loved the lighter escapism and beautiful prose
Good, but I want something darker

small-gods.title: Small Gods
small-gods.author: Terry Pratchett
small-gods.description: Terry Pratchett takes the piss out of religion. Not in an offensive way. The man is very respectful, but there is a satirization in organized religions as a whole.
small-gods.danielQuote: Comedy in fantasy can be pretty divisive. Some really like the absurdist opportunities that the fantastic will provide. While others would rather stay well more grounded.

questions.text: How do you feel about the comedy?

options.text: Love the absurdist humor! More please!
Interesting but not my vibe, I want more epic

narnia.title: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
narnia.author: C.S. Lewis
narnia.description: A classic that verges into cozy territory, though it treats its audience maturely.

questions.text: What spoke to you about Narnia?

options.text: Liked it, but not the coziness - the mature YA elements!
This is too light, I need something more substantial

legends-and-lattes.title: Legends & Lattes
legends-and-lattes.author: Travis Baldree
legends-and-lattes.description: The flagship for the cozy genre - an orc opening a coffee shop, struggling with the day-to-day business of small city life.
legends-and-lattes.danielQuote: It is the ultimate 'sip a cup of tea, wrap yourself in a blanket' fantasy book.

house-cerulean-sea.title: The House in the Cerulean Sea
house-cerulean-sea.author: TJ Klune
house-cerulean-sea.description: Follows a LGBTQ+ protagonist as he explores a magical orphanage with mysterious children and a town that can't quite accept the other and different.
house-cerulean-sea.danielQuote: If you somehow want to go even cozier than that, I recommend you buy a blanket and start just reading the threads because we have already found your specific subgenre niche.

mistborn.title: Mistborn: The Final Empire
mistborn.author: Brandon Sanderson
mistborn.description: What if Sauron won? A mist-born orphan and a stabby Gandalf-subversion try to overthrow the evil overlord who actually succeeded in conquering the world.
mistborn.danielQuote: This is a true nexus point. We are going to lose a lot of readers here because many will go 'That guy tickled my itch' and disappear into the Cosmere. Your family is going to miss you.

options.text: The HARD MAGIC SYSTEM! I need harder!

shadow-what-was-lost.title: The Shadow of What Was Lost
shadow-what-was-lost.author: James Islington
shadow-what-was-lost.description: Slow burn hard magic system that'll creep up throughout the pages until you go 'Damn, this is hard.'

options.text: My wand needs to be MORE erect!

black-prism.title: The Black Prism
black-prism.author: Brent Weeks
black-prism.description: The most fun, flamboyant magic system - color drafting! Different colors provide different projections. Use too much and you'll break the color in your eye and lose yourself to the crazies.
black-prism.danielQuote: If you read this and think 'My wand is not even throbbing yet,' congratulations, you're a hard magic fan. I'm happy for you.

dragonbone-chair.title: The Dragonbone Chair
dragonbone-chair.author: Tad Williams
dragonbone-chair.description: An absolute sleeper slowburn staple - truly epic scale fantasy that is darker in tone without being just boiling in death. A lowly kitchen boy as the realm descends into civil war.

questions.text: How dark do you want to go?

options.text: This transitional modern-classic vibe is perfect!

eye-of-the-world.title: The Eye of the World
eye-of-the-world.author: Robert Jordan
eye-of-the-world.description: The higher, nicer writing of classic fantasy with more relatable human characters of modern fantasy.
eye-of-the-world.danielQuote: If this is spot on to scratching your itch, you're just going to continue reading The Wheel of Time. And once you finish, you're going to have a hollowness in your chest that you can never fill.

game-of-thrones.title: A Game of Thrones
game-of-thrones.author: George R.R. Martin
game-of-thrones.description: We all know the story of Westeros. Political intrigue, gray morality, and characters you love dying horribly.

options.text: Love it! But less magic, more politics
This dark level is perfect, but I want higher fantasy
The sexy stuff... I enjoyed that

blade-itself.title: The Blade Itself
blade-itself.author: Joe Abercrombie
blade-itself.description: Grimdark fantasy with most of the magic pulled out. Political intrigue with a slight fantasy backdrop and twisted tropes - one protagonist is a torturer and you'll love him.
blade-itself.danielQuote: Jobie makes you love horrible people. It's a knack he has. It sounds psychotic to say until you read the book.

black-company.title: The Black Company
black-company.author: Glen Cook
black-company.description: The darkest fantasy book Daniel has ever read. A mercenary band hired by evil people doing what mercenary bands would realistically do.
black-company.danielQuote: I can't go more deep than that without getting demonetized on YouTube. That's too far for me, dog.

berserk.title: Berserk
berserk.author: Kentaro Miura
berserk.description: A manga about Guts, someone deeply traumatized who spends a long time trying to realize that joy can still be felt maybe kind of for a day.
berserk.danielQuote: If you want darker than Black Company, one: go to therapy. And two: congratulations, you found your niche. It is grimdark.

kushiels-dart.title: Kushiel's Dart
kushiels-dart.author: Jacqueline Carey
kushiels-dart.description: The grand papa/mama of romantasy. It treats sex like a magic system and is a well worth reading fantasy epic on its own.
kushiels-dart.danielQuote: Few trigger warnings are in there for sure. Look them up on your own.

elric-melnibone.title: Elric of Melniboné
elric-melnibone.author: Michael Moorcock
elric-melnibone.description: Our Australian boy! Higher epic fantasy with a deeply psychological focus on what it means to be someone with incredible power and moral failings. You have curses, dark destiny, and a sword that soul steals.
elric-melnibone.danielQuote: When I heard the audiobook narrator say 'Elric of Melniboné', how was I that wrong? I really think this is a special book.

options.text: Perfect! Want more modern epic like this

gardens-of-moon.title: Gardens of the Moon
gardens-of-moon.author: Steven Erikson
gardens-of-moon.description: The biggest step a fantasy fan can take. Don't worry, you will be confused. Eventually, you'll love it. It's not a story of a person or nation - it's the story of EVERYTHING.
gardens-of-moon.danielQuote: I am so proud of you for even being willing to take this journey.

golden-compass.title: The Golden Compass
golden-compass.author: Philip Pullman
golden-compass.description: A litmus test for urban fantasy. Full of commentary in an alternative closeworld setting with real world elements. Lyra and her daemon investigate mysteries involving her lineage, Dust, and other worlds while witches exist.

options.text: I want even MORE real-world settings!
The commentary! I want more adult commentary

magicians.title: The Magicians
magicians.author: Lev Grossman
magicians.description: Academic setting in the real world where a boy learns magic in school. Definitely some 'I don't like society, I'm a special boy' vibes done well.

dresden-files.title: Storm Front (The Dresden Files)
dresden-files.author: Jim Butcher
dresden-files.description: Real-world epic urban fantasy. Fair warning: it's hornier.
dresden-files.danielQuote: And from Kayla: you should eventually read Anita Blake and after book six be disappointed because it's important that you learn fantasy authors will eventually disappoint you.

perdido-street-station.title: Perdido Street Station
perdido-street-station.author: China Miéville
perdido-street-station.description: The most controversial recommendation! New Weird - people having relationships with bug people. Covers energy crisis, crime, prejudice in bizarre ways.
perdido-street-station.danielQuote: Listen, listen. There's good logic behind this. It is a wonderful filter.

options.text: Eh, but I liked the sci-fantasy angle

ninth-house.title: Ninth House
ninth-house.author: Leigh Bardugo
ninth-house.description: Dark academia mystery - a young investigative woman looks into dark underground societies within an academic setting. Surprisingly dark.
ninth-house.danielQuote: This is actually my favorite story of hers. I like it more than Shadow and Bone.

options.text: Love it! But from a horny male perspective
Want to test my dark academia tastes more

deadly-education.title: A Deadly Education
deadly-education.author: Naomi Novik
deadly-education.description: Dark academia with romance elements. A gateway to see if you like romance in your fantasy.

magic-bites.title: Magic Bites
magic-bites.author: Ilona Andrews
magic-bites.description: Urban romantasy that gets your wand throbbing.

old-kingdom.title: Sabriel (Old Kingdom)
old-kingdom.author: Garth Nix
old-kingdom.description: YA that treats its audience maturely. Two lands divided by a wall - one of tech, one of magic. Sabriel's magic deals in death, handling themes of mortality and duty.
old-kingdom.danielQuote: I think this is one of the best, if not the best YA epics ever.

six-of-crows.title: Six of Crows
six-of-crows.author: Leigh Bardugo
six-of-crows.description: YA with interesting worldbuilding based in Russian lore and mythos.

eragon.title: Eragon
eragon.author: Christopher Paolini
eragon.description: If you're over 25, let's be honest, you've read that.

last-unicorn.title: The Last Unicorn
last-unicorn.author: Peter S. Beagle
last-unicorn.description: Fairy tale fantasy with surreal elements and animal companions.

will-of-many.title: The Will of the Many
will-of-many.author: James Islington
will-of-many.description: Modern epic based on classical culture. Non-medieval fantasy where you can trust nobody, everybody's a suspect.

green-bone-saga.title: Jade City (Green Bone Saga)
green-bone-saga.author: Fonda Lee
green-bone-saga.description: The best urban fantasy epic ever. Reservoir Dogs meets Godfather meets Kill Bill. Corruption arcs, characters making horrendous decisions, generational change, and why family tears us apart.
green-bone-saga.danielQuote: You will see characters make horrendous decisions and love them for it while your heart breaks from their actions.

options.text: A bit less epic, but keep urban fantasy

divine-rivals.title: Divine Rivals
divine-rivals.author: Rebecca Ross
divine-rivals.description: Two people communicate through magical typewriters while there's mythos around gods in a WWI-ish setting. Has romance angle.

middlegame.title: Middlegame
middlegame.author: Seanan McGuire
middlegame.description: Alternative fantasy with complex time-bending narrative.

dark-tower.title: The Gunslinger (Dark Tower)
dark-tower.author: Stephen King
dark-tower.description: Dark epic urban fantasy with one of the best opening lines ever. The gunslinger jumps through worlds and Stephen King stories hunting the man in black. Controversial for its ending.

options.text: Less epic but want the horror!

pet-sematary.title: Pet Sematary
pet-sematary.author: Stephen King
pet-sematary.description: The author's a horror writer, so here you go. Spooky vibes.

options.text: Too much, want dark but less horror

gideon-ninth.title: Gideon the Ninth
gideon-ninth.author: Tamsyn Muir
gideon-ninth.description: Lesbian necromancers in space. Dark but with humor. Good for alt fantasy fans too.
gideon-ninth.danielQuote: If after all these recommendations you still didn't even like Gideon the Ninth, I'm sorry. I cannot help you anymore.

cozy-fantasy-fan.title: Cozy Fantasy Fan
cozy-fantasy-fan.description: You've found your niche! You want to sip tea, wrap yourself in a blanket, and read about orcs opening coffee shops.
recommendations: The House in the Cerulean Sea
cozy-fantasy-fan.danielQuote: If you want cozier than House in the Cerulean Sea, I recommend you buy a blanket and start just reading the threads.

hard-magic-fan.title: Hard Magic System Fan
hard-magic-fan.description: You little freak. Your wand is throbbing for those detailed, intricate magic systems.
hard-magic-fan.danielQuote: If you read Black Prism and think 'My wand is not even throbbing yet,' then I'm just going to say you're a hard magic fan and good, I'm happy for you.

grimdark-fan.title: Grimdark Fan
grimdark-fan.description: You want humanity questioning whether it should be saved. Nail-biting, dark, morally gray excellence.
recommendations: A Song of Ice and Fire
grimdark-fan.danielQuote: If you read Black Company and think 'This is perfect,' congratulations. You found your niche.

grimdark-fan-seek-therapy.title: Maximum Grimdark Fan
grimdark-fan-seek-therapy.description: If you want darker than Black Company: One, go to therapy. Two, congratulations, you found your niche.
grimdark-fan-seek-therapy.danielQuote: That's too far for me, dog. But if you read Berserk and want darker, go to therapy.

urban-fantasy-fan.title: Urban Fantasy Fan
urban-fantasy-fan.description: Magic in the modern world! Cities with secret supernatural societies!
urban-fantasy-fan.danielQuote: Congratulations. You just like urban fantasy.

dark-epic-fan.title: Dark Epic Fantasy Fan
dark-epic-fan.description: You want the darkness AND the massive scope. You're reading stories of continents, not just chosen ones.
dark-epic-fan.danielQuote: I am so proud of you for even being willing to take this journey with Malazan.

ya-fantasy-fan.title: YA Fantasy Fan
ya-fantasy-fan.description: You have the curse of endless choices. More fantasy books are published in this space than any other. You're never going to catch up. Sorry.

romantasy-fan.title: Romantasy Fan
romantasy-fan.description: Sex and magic and epic storylines! No judgment here, that's absolutely fine.
recommendations: A Court of Thorns and Roses
romantasy-fan.danielQuote: Few trigger warnings are in there for sure. Look them up on your own.

modern-fantasy-fan.title: Modern Fantasy Fan
modern-fantasy-fan.description: You love the contemporary stylings of fantasy while keeping the epic scope.
modern-fantasy-fan.danielQuote: Jack the box. You're a modern fantasy fan.

new-weird-fan.title: New Weird Fan
new-weird-fan.description: Bug people relationships! Energy crisis commentary! You're Daniel's favorite type of freak.
new-weird-fan.danielQuote: Get your freak on. Don't let nobody stop you.

cosmere-addict.title: Cosmere Addict
cosmere-addict.description: See you in 6 months when you're ready to take a break. Your family is going to miss you.
cosmere-addict.danielQuote: We are going to lose a lot of readers here because many will go 'That guy tickled my itch' and disappear into the Cosmere.

wheel-of-time-addict.title: Wheel of Time Fan
wheel-of-time-addict.description: Once you finish, you're going to have a hollowness in your chest that you can never fill.
wheel-of-time-addict.danielQuote: If this is spot on to scratching your itch, you're going to have a hollowness in your chest that you can never fill. But that's the end result of finishing any series you love.
